verdict.rationale: Docs mention a CLI type-checking tool (`npx sv check`) that inspects Svelte code, implying broader-than-script-block checking, but no evidence explicitly confirms markup/template expressions are type-checked or shows IDE integration for template type errors. Community feedback notes IDE/TypeScript support has historically been an issue. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of template-level type checking, editor/IDE diagnostics in markup, and independent confirmation of accuracy.
